name: WAON-Bench-with-images
description:
WAON-Bench: Japanese Cultural Image Classification Dataset
	



WAON-Bench is a manually curated image classification dataset designed to benchmark Vision-Language models on Japanese culture.
The dataset contains 374 classes across 8 categories: animals, buildings, events, everyday life, food, nature, scenery, and traditions. Each class includes 5 images.

	
		
	
	
		How to Use
	

from datasets import load_dataset

ds = load_dataset("speed/WAON-Bench")


	
	
	
		Data Collection… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/speed/WAON-Bench-with-images.
reputation: A curated, niche dataset for evaluating vision-language models on Japanese cultural classes; limited but useful for cultural-knowledge evaluation.
